evidence.quote: A near-real-time relay to monitoring stations on the ground would allow marine and conservation scientists to more accurately predict and react to coral bleaching events.
Reef-monitoring satellites could also be used to report sea surface temperatures, thermal stress on coral, and bathymetry

criteria.reasoning: Clear motivation, users (marine/conservation scientists) and functions identified with cited literature. However, no explicit mission objectives, quantitative requirements (resolution, revisit, coverage) or feasibility discussion of the seafloor-colour sensing concept, so not fully accomplished.

evidence.quote: Project work will be divided into weeks via a Gantt Chart. Detailed task descriptions can be found on the next page.
The goal is to brainstorm and research as many possible strategies for the satellite’s launch/orbit and then gradually cut and refine them

criteria.reasoning: Detailed week-by-week Gantt chart with task descriptions tied to mission needs (launch, orbit, ground control, comms) and a sources list. Plan is credible and feasible, but no contingency/variation provisions and no justification of schedule risks, so not accomplished.

evidence.quote: I have read the brief of Asner’s monitoring system in Hawaii, researched into how coral bleaching occurs and its severity

criteria.reasoning: Progress is limited to background reading, mission concept drafting and STK tutorials. No preliminary technical results (orbit parameters, coverage, link budgets, hand calculations) or interpretation are presented, so only minor work is demonstrated.

evidence.quote: Coral reefs harbour some of the most diverse species of life on the planet
Completed stages are gold. Incomplete stages are blue. Deadlines are indicated by red lines.

criteria.reasoning: Well-written, logically structured with clear headings, consistent formatting, labelled Gantt chart with legend, and footnote citations matching listed sources. Minor weakness: the 'Useful Links' list is not cited in text, preventing a higher mark.

technical_issues.issue: No quantitative mission requirements (spatial resolution, revisit time, swath, spectral bands) despite citing 100 m/pixel bathymetry gap; seafloor-colour bleaching detection implies demanding high-resolution multispectral imaging not yet addressed.
No preliminary orbit or coverage analysis performed; near-real-time relay claim is unquantified (LEO revisit vs GEO trade-off not discussed).
Gantt chart shows 'STK Simulations' spanning Wk 4–10 but no simulation outputs are reported, inconsistent with claimed progress.

overall: A well-presented, clearly written preliminary report with a compelling Australian reef-monitoring mission concept, a detailed Gantt-chart plan and cited sources. Weaknesses: no formal mission requirements, no contingency planning, and preliminary progress limited to tutorials with no technical results.
